summary: Design skills taxonomies, talent marketplace workflows, and workforce plans aligned with AI roadmaps. Explore the five-day course and practical outputs.
lede: Skills-based organization design helps HR and workforce teams connect skills data to workforce planning and internal opportunities. For HR leaders, talent and learning heads, workforce planners, and transformation teams, the training covers designing skills taxonomies, governing skills data, mapping internal opportunity workflows, and assessing workforce scenarios alongside AI and automation plans. Applied exercises produce a taxonomy blueprint, governance matrix, and phased implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals shaping skills data, internal talent movement, and workforce decisions across HR and transformation functions.
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR, talent management, learning and development, workforce planning, people analytics, organizational design, or transformation work is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel for worksheet-based exercises; advanced AI and automation topics are addressed at conceptual and operational planning level, not technical implementation level.
